understanding: This is a brand positioning doc, not the app itself, but it directly addresses my concerns: it names 'opt-in,' 'skip, pause, and frequency controls' as core design values, explicitly rules out unskippable or every-time interruptions in the objection-handling table, and keeps the first action small (one question). It also quotes my own worry back accurately and doesn't overclaim results.
nice_to_have: The doc mentions an iPhone Shortcuts setup guide and admits real-device automation isn't proven yet (issue #3) — before I'd trust this, I'd want to know the actual setup takes a few minutes, not something I have to debug like homework.
Would like the landing copy to state the skip option as plainly as the subhead states frequency control, so it's not just implied.
